desc: Camera pose matches the milestone's roll angle/pitch — upright at M1, past-vertical at M2, emerging-inverted at M3, fully upside-down at M4 — so the 360° CCW barrel roll reads structurally.
Correct world tint + tower colourway for the beat: saturated silk-road green early, near-black at the seam, silk-road-2.0 purple/blue after — no palette bleed across the swap.
At inversion the world colour and tower emission fall to near-black with only a few faint streaked lights left, fully hiding the green→purple world swap.
The emissive hero tower reads as a circuit-board megastructure — gridded windows, glowing crown, legible 'Silk Road / 2.0' signage on the purple side — not a plain lit block.
The dark ground plane carries a dense field of tiny emissive city lights and lesser towers receding to a low horizon, giving the aerial dive its scale and depth.
Wispy dark cloud/nebula haze wraps the upper frame and tower glow blooms into it, keeping the near-black background atmospheric rather than flat.
Weighty continuous motion blur on the roll/dive plus a moody low-key cinematic grade — deep crushed blacks, controlled emissive bloom, no clipped or milky shadows.
